    About Company

    Welcome To Aeroflex Industries

    With over three decades of expertise in manufacturing stainless steel flexible flow solutions, Aeroflex Industries has established itself as a trusted global brand. Headquartered in India, the company specializes in designing and producing high-performance flexible metal hoses, assemblies, and fittings for diverse industrial applications.

    Aeroflex caters to diverse industries such as data centre, Oil & Gas, Chemical, Petrochemical, Power, Railways, HVAC, Marine, and Infrastructure sectors worldwide. The company provides a comprehensive range of corrugated stainless steel hoses, composite hoses, metal expansion joints, and customized assemblies, all engineered to withstand extreme operating conditions, including high pressure, elevated temperatures, and corrosive environments, ensuring durability, safety, and consistent performance.

    Customers trust Aeroflex flexible flow solutions for reliable,
    high-performance critical applications.
